newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea says appoints new acting premier.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea says appoints new acting premier.

text.p: North Korea announced on Friday the appointment of an acting premier to replace Kang Song San, one of the most powerful figures in the country's power structure and its sixth-ranked official.
A report on Pyongyang Radio, monitored by Tokyo-based Radiopress which monitors North Korea's media, said Vice Premier Hong Song Nam was appointed acting premier.
The report gave no reason for why Hong, 73, was taking over the post of premier, held by Kang, 66, since December 1992.
But Radiopress analyst Noriyuki Suzuki said Kang had been a long-time diabetes sufferer and had not been seen in public since January 1996.
Suzuki said Kang had ranked sixth in North Korea's power structure while Hong, a vice premier since October 1987 and a Politburo alternate member since March 1989, had been ranked 19th.
The announcement added to speculation about turmoil in North Korea's leadership since the defection in Beijing on February 12 of Hwang Jang-yop, a close advisor to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il.
